name: jrtropicalfish
description: Orquestador de desarrollo de JR Tropical Fish: levanta infraestructura, API y web con un solo comando.

scripts.predev: node scripts/stop.mjs --keep-docker --silencioso && docker compose up -d --wait && node scripts/s3-init.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.migracion:nueva: dotnet ef migrations add --project apps/api/src/JRTropicalFish.Infrastructure --startup-project apps/api/src/JRTropicalFish.Api --output-dir Persistence/Migrations
